protocol.residual_roles: Single chronological forward cross-fit: base fit/checkpoint <=Oct29 or Dec29; next14 dates correction fit, next14 calibration, next14 assessment; I210 winter transfers frozen autumn prior. No in-sample base labels.
protocol.temporal_model: Same-day local posterior from <=512 lawful visible anchors. Each anchor frozen prediction obtained while all four own measurement channels are withheld in one of2 seeded folds; target predictions remain the original frozen cache. Hours since current day start; no cross-date anchor pooling.
protocol.residual_amplitude: Per-channel RMS fitted only on <=512 held-out correction_fit target residuals per date, clipped [.05,1]. Fixed before calibration. Same amplitudes for every kernel.
protocol.graph_control: Existing state_assimilation.assimilate_residuals with the exact same sampled counterfactual anchor residuals and trusted edges; fixed precisions (1,1,1). Not a claim to reproduce historical A58 exact settings.
protocol.selection: Highest calibration official State among strengths [0,.25,.5,1] separately per preregistered kernel/control; ties prefer 0. Save seal then open assessment.
protocol.assessment: Report baseline, all matched cal-selected strengths and fixed full-strength variants. No selection on assessment.
protocol.primary_comparison: directional vs ordinary and gated_ordinary selected on calibration; graph control and frozen strong model also reported
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 paired circular date-block samples of length7; nonlinear State macro recomputed; omit missing-regime draws
protocol.promotion: Requires State gain>=.002, pooled lower95>0, each direction gain>=-.001, both seasons and independent gain over ordinary kernel. Otherwise do not expand.
protocol.metric_scope: Official eligibility/regime/family formula on selected two directions, not all ten-direction competition State. Trusted-component-only State and coverage are secondary diagnostics. Public observed inventory-increment proxy only; no hidden b* equality.
